resources.name: Academic Advising
resources.location: By appointment, in person or virtual
resources.description: Advisors assist students with academic, career, and transfer planning, and are available to all JCC students. Success Navigators assist students in the transition to college and connect them to advisors and other resources.

resources.name: Career Services
resources.location: Jamestown Campus, 525 Falconer Street, Jamestown, NY 14702
resources.description: Career Services at Jamestown Community College helps students and alumni explore and prepare for careers, with support for writing resumes, interviewing, internships, and experiencing a job firsthand.

resources.name: Student Food Pantry
resources.location: Jamestown Campus: next to the Campus Bookstore, Hamilton Collegiate Center, first floor. Cattaraugus County Campus: Success Center across from the bookstore, College Center, first floor.
resources.description: Jamestown Community College maintains a food pantry for all students on the Jamestown Campus and Cattaraugus County Campus, with an assortment of donated food items and hygiene products.

resources.name: Health Center
resources.location: Jamestown Campus: COCE 122; Cattaraugus County Campus: COLL 139
resources.description: JCC's health centers support the health and well-being of all students and employees, including help with seasonal illnesses like influenza, RSV, or COVID-19 and other health concerns.

resources.name: Financial Aid & Billing
resources.description: JCC Financial Aid & Billing helps students understand their financial aid, student bill, and options to help pay for college, including questions about FAFSA, financial aid requirements, and financial aid status.

resources.name: IT Help Desk
resources.description: The JCC IT Help Desk is the central point of contact for technology support across all JCC campuses, providing technical assistance to students, faculty, and staff.
